title: Histological and histomorphometrical evaluation of two types of bone substitutes in combination with i -PRF for bone regeneration in critical bone defects: An in vivo study Ribeiro de
authors: Albuquerque Boia, J., Soares, L. F. F., Passos, G. P., dos Santos Neves, J., Mariano, R. C., & Vital Ribeiro Junior, N. (2022). Journal of Osseointegration, 14(4), 217–225.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “According to the results obtained in this study, it was observed that Cerabone® and Bio- Oss®, associated with i -PRF, exhibited a satisfactory applicability to fill critical defects, favoring the bone regeneration process” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
